description.value:
Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to pull off an upper hand technique instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Charisma modifier.

Brutal Hit. Against a target within 15 feet, it attempts a Strength save or is knocked prone.

Low Blow. Against a target within 15 feet, it attempts a Constitution save or is stunned until the start of its next turn.

Shank Shot. Against a target within 15 feet, it attempts a Dexterity save. On a failure, it gains one level of slowed and makes Dexterity saves with disadvantage until the end of its next turn.
